ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions ? (1 mark)
   A. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions .
   D. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions  has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Modes of preservation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Modes of preservation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Modes of preservation of the Qur’an.
   D. Say Modes of preservation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Waste food daily

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in revealed scriptures? (1 mark)
   A. Use Belief in revealed scriptures to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in revealed scriptures with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in revealed scriptures.
   D. Say Belief in revealed scriptures has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Commanding good and forbidding evil? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Commanding good and forbidding evil with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Commanding good and forbidding evil has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Commanding good and forbidding evil to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Commanding good and forbidding evil.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

7. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected verses has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hajj and Umrah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hajj and Umrah has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T.
   B. Use Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Virtues in Islam 06 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam 16 6 Muamalat 6.1 Divorce 04 6.2 T with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Ulum al- Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Ulum al- Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ulum al- Hadith.
   C. Say Ulum al- Hadith has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Ulum al- Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Divorce and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Types of divorce and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Trade and Finance in Islam 06 6.4 Human Rights 06 7 Islamic Heritage and Civilis and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Trade and Finance in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
